_comment: Source of truth for public programmes when Supabase is unavailable. Built from KEITH'S TRAINING SCHEDULE (Drive) and the Nov 2026 roadshow brief as at 4 Nov 2026. Only confirmed sessions are listed. Do not add CPD hours or HRD Corp claimability unless confirmed. provider: bk-training | high-impact | bk-academy | external (then set organiser). Past public sessions (2024 to 2026) were added from the schedule: dates, topics, organisers and venues only; in-house client sessions, fees and contact names are excluded.
